method: Found with ordinary web search by a person-directed assistant. NO page was fetched and NO posting was checked: every candidate is `unverified` until the read-only Stage 2 liveness check. The search results were weak (many hits were aggregators, vendors' demo boards or old postings), so this list is deliberately short and nothing was added to fill a platform quota.

gaps.ashby: No jobs.ashbyhq.com posting surfaced in search. Production discovery holds one Ashby job (id 2), plus NerdWallet from Stage 0. An owner-supplied URL is the way to add more.

gaps.workday: One candidate, and its human page URL was derived from the API path the search returned, so it needs checking.
gaps.workable: One candidate, from 2023: a stale-posting control, not a current posting.
